plan.title: feat(swarm): OpenClaw platform descriptor + capability matrix (Tier 1 sessions_spawn)

narratives.Description: Add OpenClaw as first-class runtime descriptor in swarm Phase 3 capability/launch matrix with sessions_spawn Tier 1 and verify:openclaw-tier1. This is the P0 spine of epic #2874. Cursor and grok-build already have Tier-1 descriptors; OpenClaw sessions_spawn must not fall through to generic-terminal.
narratives.Overview: Epic #2874 P0 spine. Mirror Cursor #1877 / grok-build #1342 treatment for OpenClaw sessions_spawn.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive orchestrator on OpenClaw, I want a first-class openclaw platform descriptor and capability matrix, so that sessions_spawn is treated as Tier 1 instead of generic-terminal degradation.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Update content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md Phase 3 capability matrix to probe sessions_spawn and set descriptor openclaw as Tier 1. Step 2: Extend packages/core/src/platform/ and packages/core/src/swarm/ routing so openclaw is a valid dispatch_provider. Step 3: Add task verify:openclaw-tier1 (mirror verify:cursor-tier1) under tasks/ and wire into docs/agents-entry if required. Step 4: Unit or gate tests proving matrix markers fail closed when removed. Step 5: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #2875. Verification: task verify:openclaw-tier1; task check:merge. Touch concrete source files listed in plan.metadata.swarm.file_scope.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance criteria map to #2875; missing_traces_justification until implementation maps lines.

narrative.Acceptance: Given swarm Phase 3 capability matrix / detection code, when sessions_spawn is present, then descriptor openclaw (or documented split) is Tier 1 and not misclassified as grok-build/generic-terminal.
